qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise service territories in Missouri and Illinois. Customers have zero practical or legal alternatives for grid electric and gas distribution. Formula cost-of-service ratemaking with fuel adjustments provides inflation pass-through, though authorized returns cap overall ROIC at 5-6%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated electric and gas monopoly with exclusive service territory in Missouri and Illinois. However, perpetual high capital intensity ($4.1B+ capex exceeding OCF) and heavy leverage ($18.2B long-term debt, 12.5x net income, interest coverage 2.6x) create structural dependence on continuous capital market access, while regulated ROIC is capped at ~5.5-6.0%.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC of 5.5% reflects regulatory rate caps. FY2025 EBIT of $2,026M against interest expense of $776M yields 2.61x interest coverage, well below the 5.0x hurdle. Long-term debt of $18,214M is 12.5x net income ($1,461M). FCF after capex ($4,128M) is negative (-$775M). Standard regulated utility capital structure dependent on continuous external financing.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
